items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Like Louis Armstrong, King Cole. And those bands would come in during that time to play dances, concert, and we would fill in a standby group.

ctx.x: Sounds like a good night singing. Where did you play? Any special longer engagements?

Well, we just played all engagements around town. We would play after the bands or before the bands would come. Like Louis Armstrong, King Cole. And those bands would come in during that time to play dances, concert, and we would fill in a standby group.
